name: Example: public safety ERCES, 3-storey office (completed example)

data.construction: Thermally efficient (low-E glass, foil insulation), typical (31 dB)
data.next_step: Annual retest: book access with the owner by mid-September 2027
data.notes:
Completed worked example (fictional building, people and companies; the radio systems are real FCC licences near the pin). It shows a job the way it looks once it is finished and In service.
The free-space pre-survey said every system clears −95 dBm inside; the walk before design found −98 to −104 dBm on floors 2 and 3 behind the low-E glass, so the building needed a system.
Built: one Class A BDA (800 MHz + VHF) in the first-floor BDA room, a fiber backbone to a remote on each floor, six ceiling antennas a floor, a 12-hour battery and an annunciator in the fire command center.
Accepted 2026-10-27 with the fire marshal witnessing: every floor passes IFC 510.5.4 with no failed area, and all five named critical areas pass. The acceptance results are saved as the baseline for the annual retests.

log.detail: Example: public safety ERCES, 3-storey office (completed example)
Site walk with Priya Raman (owner's property manager): three floors, low-E curtain wall, concrete core. The fire marshal asks for ERCES before the C of O.
Email sent: survey and next steps, to the owner
Email sent: floor plans request, to the GC
Example office - architectural plans (example).pdf (from the GC's reply)
floors: each floor given its plan page (A-101, A-102, A-103)
presurvey: KNIQ704 (800 MHz trunked) and KIC338 (VHF) ticked as the systems the fire marshal requires
Walk before design (uncalibrated quick check): −98 to −104 dBm on floors 2 and 3 behind the low-E glass. Free space said every system clears −95 dBm inside: it doesn't.
Email sent: consent request to the licensee (KNIQ704, KIC338)
checks.permit: AHJ permit issued
Rooftop readings: KNIQ704 −58 dBm, KIC338 −60 dBm (isotropic). Link budget filled from them; both bands pass every check.
Consent reply for KNIQ704: signed letter in Files. Conditions: uplink gain ≤ 40 dB; notify before activation and at each annual test.
checks.consent: licensee consent on file
Email sent: design submittal, to the fire marshal
checks.design_ok: design approved by the fire marshal
life.ul2524_checked: the BDA, fiber DAS and annunciator are listed to UL 2524 3rd edition
request for quote to Sample Supply Co. (example), Example Wireless Distribution (example)
bom: the best split chosen (each line from its cheapest supplier); order placed
Install started: riser wrap and horizontal cable (Sample Electric Co.).
PIM: floor 2 branch failed at −135 dBc; distance-to-PIM put it 84 ft out, a loose N connector at the floor 2 splitter. Retorqued; retest −149 dBc, pass.
checks.monitoring: supervision connected to the fire alarm panel; annunciator in the fire command center
Pre-acceptance check: square 3-5 VHF −94.5 dBm, 0.5 dB over the line and inside the IBflex's 1 dB accuracy. Floor 3 remote's VHF gain raised 3 dB on 10/17.
Acceptance grid test, floors 1 and 2: every square passes (IBflex EX-1001, calibrated 2026-06-15).
Acceptance grid test, floor 3 and the five named critical areas: all pass. Battery test: 12 h at full load, low-battery signal at 70%.
checks.battery: battery test passed
checks.fcc_reg: booster registered with the FCC
Witnessed acceptance with Dana Whitfield (fire marshal): spot checks on each floor and the fire pump room pass.
checks.accepted_on: 2026-10-27; retest_due: 2027-10-27; grid results saved as the acceptance baseline
ERCES acceptance test report (example).pdf
Email sent: acceptance test report, to the fire marshal
AHJ reply: report received and accepted
Email sent: acceptance and the report, to the owner
stage: Acceptance → In service

Jordan Lee

Radio system manager

We are installing an emergency responder communication enhancement system (Class A (channelized) signal booster) at the building above, as the fire marshal requires under IFC 2021 510. The booster will retransmit only KNIQ704 (19 channels) and KIC338 (2 channels).

We ask for your written consent to retransmit these channels, and for any conditions you set.

Jordan Lee

703-555-0109

Marcus
